input.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 Company non-compete to Deerskin Products only, cap at 12 months, and add internal-development/acquisition carve-out
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept restrictions on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, so our position is that the Section 6.1 covenant on the Company should come out. As a fallback we have narrowed it to Deerskin Products only (deleting the open-ended "substantially similar" products and "companies similar to" language), capped it at twelve months, and carved out internal development and acquisitions; HDI's exclusive "Deerskin" brand right and its Section 6.3 protection are unaffected.

ops.oldText: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
ops.newText: during the term of this Agreement (but in no event for more than twelve (12) months following the Effective Date), the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products

ops.text: Nothing in Section 6.1 shall restrict the Company from (i) developing, offering or selling any products other than Deerskin Products through any channel, (ii) internally developing any product, catalog or web site, or (iii) acquiring, being acquired by, or continuing to operate the business of, any person or entity engaged in the offering of apparel or accessories on the Internet.
